decision: Does native self-search learning improve certified success at a matched search budget after a repaired action representation and broader selection?
hypotheses: Explicit rule, actual premises and actual consequences resolve action aliasing.
A minimum of eight admitted proofs across at least three dependency groups supplies a meaningful replay batch.
The original eight ID-selected sentinels miss progress that a fixed 32-case all-group selection can detect.
Guarded eager initialization and stable local parameter identities make a seeded fresh model and zero-update binary snapshot produce the exact same first update.
training: Only this seed own native-search solutions after unchanged native checker and Graph admission; no imported proofs, external weights or teacher corpus.

selection.method: Original eight sentinels plus sealed-ID round-robin over every development dependency; no solver outcome filtering.
selection.promotion: Strictly greater certified development successes; no earlier-anchor regression; reject restores both incumbent weights and Adam.

confirmation.method: All remaining original-TRAIN development cases, disjoint from current-run training and selection. All three seeds finish learning before any confirmation search.
confirmation.comparator: Exact same fresh initialization and zero-update optimizer as this seed initial acquisition model.
confirmation.success: Mean certified gain >=5 percentage points, no negative seed and at least two strictly positive seeds supports a replicated finite-corpus gain.
confirmation.uncertainty: Report paired dependency-group bootstrap 95% interval across the 11 fixed groups. Broader-group generalization requires its lower bound above zero; otherwise remains inconclusive.

exclusions: Original internal 241 reserved questions and original external validation/calibration/test never searched, trained or selected. Interest labels are never truth labels.
limitations: Development corpus has historical engineering reuse; confirmation is prospective for this run, not a new independent external test.
Pilot seed 653 and all of its weights/proofs are excluded from the main run. Expanded selection pilot observed 4/32 -> 6/32; it is selection evidence only.
Actual total training compute is additional to initialization and inference; paired inference budgets match.
No physical multi-host, production, hosted-CI or full Cargo matrix qualification.
stopping: Exactly three fresh seeds, two acquisition/training rounds each, one frozen confirmation. Preserve negative results; do not tune on confirmation.
